swimming trunks in Latin

swimming trunks

subligāculum balneāre

Neo-LatinDraft
  • subligāculum balneāre — swimming trunks modern (Traupman 389)
  • subligāculum natātōrium — swimming trunks modern also used (M-O 38 s.v. swimsuit)

See also: swimsuit.
